## One live-state correction the planner MUST carry (non-blocking)

The body's per-file literal counts were measured before — or without accounting
for — the **#2155 SKILL.md step-split**, which relocated every `### Step` procedure
body out of `.claude/skills/issue/SKILL.md` into
`.claude/skills/issue/steps/NN-*.md`. Two consequences:

1. The body's per-file table (e.g. "2 hits in `.claude/skills/issue/SKILL.md`") is
   not a reliable surface list any more. `.claude/skills/issue/steps/09-step-5.md`
   already shows cap-coupled text at L1252 and L1336 that the body's table does not
   name at all, and `.claude/skills/issue/markers.md` (L158, L235) likewise.
2. Therefore the planner **re-derives the surface set live** rather than trusting
   the body's counts, and the acceptance-criterion-2 zero-stale sweep must cover
   `.claude/skills/issue/steps/**` and `.claude/skills/issue/markers.md`
   explicitly.

The body's own qualifier already anticipates this ("Also carrying cap-coupled text
— verify during planning, counts not in the grep above"); this note makes the
`steps/**` split the concrete reason.
